description: Zoom REST API connector (read-only). Surfaces the authenticated user's scheduled meetings as `zoom:meeting` items in the local index via `GET /v2/users/me/meetings?type=scheduled`. Bearer OAuth auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`; token is a short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the 3-legged OAuth flow; never logged). The SaaS host (api.zoom.us) is fixed. Recordings and transcripts are deferred follow-ups (PR-3).
author: Nimbus
